name: Guest Order Migrator for WooCommerce
author: Poly Plugins

sections.description:
The Guest Order Migrator for WooCommerce plugin provides logged-in customers with the ability to migrate any past guest orders associated with their email into their WooCommerce account. This feature is beneficial for both customers and store owners, ensuring that all order histories are easily accessible in one place.

Key Features:

  • Automated Guest Order Detection: Finds any past guest orders made with the customer’s email address.
  • Simple Migration Process: Adds a migration link to the orders page in the customer account.
  • AJAX-Powered Migration: Provides a smooth, responsive experience.
  • WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) Compatibility: Fully compatible with HPOS.
sections.installation:
1. Backup WordPress
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
